name: Structural Dynamics Laboratory
description: Response of structures and its elements against extreme loading events. Model testing: models, of plates, shells, and frames; free and forced vibrations; evaluation of dynamic modulus; beam vibrations; vibration isolation; shear wall building model; time and frequency-domain study. Smart materials; photogrammetry for displacement measurement; vibration characteristics of RC beams using piezoelectric sensors etc.
